title: Top 100 Sher of Broken Heart and Pain
format: Roman Urdu sher + poet + short easy English meaning

sher.sher:
jab khafa hota hai to yun dil ko samjhata hun main
aaj hai na-mehrban kal mehrban ho jaega
sher.easy_english_meaning: I hope today's anger will become love tomorrow.

sher.sher:
hazaron khwahishen aisi ki har khwahish pe dam nikle
bahut nikle mere arman lekin phir bhi kam nikle
sher.easy_english_meaning: Endless desires leave the heart unsatisfied.

sher.sher:
ye na thi hamari qismat ki visal-e-yar hota
agar aur jite rahte yahi intizar hota
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love was never meant to be mine.

sher.sher:
aah ko chahiye ek umr asar hote tak
kaun jita hai teri zulf ke sar hote tak
sher.easy_english_meaning: Some prayers take longer than a lifetime.

sher.sher:
dil-e-nadan tujhe hua kya hai
aakhir is dard ki dawa kya hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: My heart hurts, but no cure is known.

sher.sher:
koi ummid bar nahin aati
koi surat nazar nahin aati
sher.easy_english_meaning: No hope and no way forward remain.

sher.sher:
maut ka ek din muayyan hai
neend kyun raat bhar nahin aati
sher.easy_english_meaning: Death is certain, yet worry steals sleep.

sher.sher:
hum ko un se wafa ki hai ummid
jo nahin jaante wafa kya hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: I expect loyalty from someone who knows none.

sher.sher:
tere wade par jiye hum to ye jaan jhut jaana
ki khushi se mar na jate agar e'tibar hota
sher.easy_english_meaning: I survived because I never fully trusted your promise.

sher.sher:
ishq ne 'ghalib' nikamma kar diya
warna hum bhi aadmi the kaam ke
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love made me useless to the world.

sher.sher:
dil hi to hai na sang-o-khisht dard se bhar na aaye kyun
roenge hum hazar bar koi hamein sataye kyun
sher.easy_english_meaning: A heart is soft; pain naturally makes it cry.

sher.sher:
dard minnat-kash-e-dawa na hua
main na achchha hua bura na hua
sher.easy_english_meaning: My pain refused every cure.

sher.sher:
qaid-e-hayat o band-e-gham asl mein donon ek hain
maut se pahle aadmi gham se najat pae kyun
sher.easy_english_meaning: Life and sorrow feel like the same prison.

sher.sher:
ishrat-e-qatra hai dariya mein fana ho jaana
dard ka had se guzarna hai dawa ho jaana
sher.easy_english_meaning: Extreme pain can finally become its own cure.

sher.sher:
ranj se khugar hua insan to mit jata hai ranj
mushkilen mujh par padin itni ki aasan ho gain
sher.easy_english_meaning: Too much hardship can make pain feel normal.

sher.sher:
koi mere dil se puchhe tere tir-e-nim-kash ko
ye khalish kahan se hoti jo jigar ke par hota
sher.easy_english_meaning: An unfinished wound hurts the longest.

sher.sher:
gham-e-hasti ka 'asad' kis se ho juz marg ilaj
shama har rang mein jalti hai sahar hone tak
sher.easy_english_meaning: Life's sorrow burns on until the end.

sher.sher:
nukta-chin hai gham-e-dil us ko sunaye na bane
kya bane baat jahan baat banaye na bane
sher.easy_english_meaning: I cannot even explain my heart's pain.

sher.sher:
ki mere qatl ke baad us ne jafa se tauba
hae us zud-pashiman ka pashiman hona
sher.easy_english_meaning: Regret came only after the damage was done.

sher.sher:
aage aati thi haal-e-dil pe hansi
ab kisi baat par nahin aati
sher.easy_english_meaning: Pain has taken away even my laughter.

sher.sher:
dagh-e-firaq-e-sohbat-e-shab ki jali hui
ek shama rah gai hai so wo bhi khamosh hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: Separation leaves only a fading silent light.

sher.sher:
aata hai dagh-e-hasrat-e-dil ka shumar yaad
mujh se mere gunah ka hisab ai khuda na mang
sher.easy_english_meaning: My unfulfilled desires are already punishment enough.

sher.sher:
ji dhundta hai phir wahi fursat ki raat din
baithe rahen tasawwur-e-jaanan kiye hue
sher.easy_english_meaning: My heart longs for quiet days spent remembering you.

sher.sher:
be-khudi be-sabab nahin 'ghalib'
kuchh to hai jis ki parda-dari hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: This lost state hides a deeper pain.

sher.sher:
hum wahan hain jahan se hum ko bhi
kuchh hamari khabar nahin aati
sher.easy_english_meaning: I am so lost I no longer know myself.

sher.sher:
ishq se tabiat ne zist ka maza paya
dard ki dawa pai dard-e-be-dawa paya
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love gave life meaning but also incurable pain.

sher.sher:
rah-e-dur-e-ishq mein rota hai kya
aage aage dekhiye hota hai kya
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love's road has harder pain still ahead.

sher.sher:
aag the ibtida-e-ishq mein hum
ab jo hain khak intiha hai ye
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love began as fire and ended in ashes.

sher.sher:
yaad us ki itni khub nahin 'mir' baz aa
nadan phir wo ji se bhulaya na jaega
sher.easy_english_meaning: Remembering too much makes forgetting impossible.

sher.sher:
ishq ek 'mir' bhaari patthar hai
kab ye tujh na-tawan se uthta hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love is a burden too heavy for a weak heart.

sher.sher:
sirhane 'mir' ke koi na bolo
abhi tuk rote rote so gaya hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: He finally slept after crying for so long.

sher.sher:
jab ki pahlu se yar uthta hai
dard be-ikhtiyar uthta hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: When the beloved leaves, pain rises by itself.

sher.sher:
patta patta buta buta haal hamara jaane hai
jaane na jaane gul hi na jaane bagh to sara jaane hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: Everyone sees my pain except the one I love.

sher.sher:
ab to jate hain but-kade se 'mir'
phir milenge agar khuda laya
sher.easy_english_meaning: I leave now; fate may or may not reunite us.

sher.sher:
dikhai diye yun ki be-khud kiya
hamein aap se bhi juda kar chale
sher.easy_english_meaning: One glimpse of you made me lose myself.

sher.sher:
hamare aage tera jab kisu ne nam liya
dil-e-sitam-zada ko hum ne tham tham liya
sher.easy_english_meaning: Hearing your name makes my wounded heart shake.

sher.sher:
koi tum sa bhi kash tum ko mile
mudda'a hum ko intiqam se hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: May you meet someone who treats you as you treated me.

sher.sher:
ab kar ke faramosh to nashad karoge
par hum jo na honge to bahut yaad karoge
sher.easy_english_meaning: You may forget me now, but later you will miss me.

sher.sher:
kya kahen kuchh kaha nahin jata
ab to chup bhi raha nahin jata
sher.easy_english_meaning: Pain is too much to speak or stay silent.

sher.sher:
dekho to dil ki jaan se uthta hai
ye dhuan sa kahan se uthta hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: This smoke of grief rises from deep inside.

sher.sher:
ulti ho gain sab tadbiren kuchh na dawa ne kaam kiya
dekha is bimari-e-dil ne aakhir kaam tamam kiya
sher.easy_english_meaning: No cure worked; heartbreak defeated everything.

sher.sher:
sham se kuchh bujha sa rahta hai
dil hua hai chiragh muflis ka
sher.easy_english_meaning: My heart burns weakly like a poor man's lamp.

sher.sher:
mujh ko shair na kaho 'mir' ki sahib maine
dard-o-gham kitne kiye jama to diwan kiya
sher.easy_english_meaning: My poetry is simply collected pain and sorrow.

sher.sher:
dil wo nagar nahin ki phir abad ho sake
pachhtaoge suno ho ye basti ujad kar
sher.easy_english_meaning: Once this heart is ruined, it may never heal.

sher.sher:
kya kahun tum se main ki kya hai ishq
jaan ka rog hai bala hai ishq
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love is an illness of the soul.

sher.sher:
hasti apni habab ki si hai
ye numaish sarab ki si hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: Life is fragile and temporary like a bubble.

sher.sher:
tum mere paas hote ho goya
jab koi dusra nahin hota
sher.easy_english_meaning: In loneliness, your memory feels beside me.

sher.sher:
tum hamare kisi tarah na hue
warna duniya mein kya nahin hota
sher.easy_english_meaning: Everything seemed possible except making you mine.

sher.sher:
wo jo hum mein tum mein qarar tha tumhein yaad ho ki na yaad ho
wahi yani wada nibah ka tumhein yaad ho ki na yaad ho
sher.easy_english_meaning: Do you still remember the promise between us?

sher.sher:
roya karenge aap bhi pahron isi tarah
atka kahin jo aap ka dil bhi meri tarah
sher.easy_english_meaning: You will understand my tears when your heart falls too.

sher.sher:
thi wasl mein bhi fikr-e-judai tamam shab
wo aaye to bhi nind na aai tamam shab
sher.easy_english_meaning: Even together, I feared separation all night.

sher.sher:
kabhi hum mein tum mein bhi chah thi kabhi hum se tum se bhi rah thi
kabhi hum bhi tum bhi the aashna tumhein yaad ho ki na yaad ho
sher.easy_english_meaning: Once we were close; do you remember?

sher.sher:
hai kuchh to baat 'momin' jo chha gai khamoshi
kis but ko de diya dil kyun but se ban gae ho
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love has left me strangely silent.

sher.sher:
kisi ka hua aaj kal tha kisi ka
na hai tu kisi ka na hoga kisi ka
sher.easy_english_meaning: A changing heart belongs truly to no one.

sher.sher:
kya mila arz-e-mudda'a kar ke
baat bhi khoi iltija kar ke
sher.easy_english_meaning: Begging for love cost me my dignity.

sher.sher:
kal tum jo bazm-e-ghair mein aankhen chura gae
khoe gae hum aise ki aghyar pa gae
sher.easy_english_meaning: Your avoidance made me feel completely lost.

sher.sher:
be-khud the ghash the mahw the duniya ka gham na tha
jina visal mein bhi to hijran se kam na tha
sher.easy_english_meaning: Even union carried the fear and pain of separation.

sher.sher:
na jae wan bane hai na bin jae chain hai
kya kijiye hamein to hai mushkil sabhi tarah
sher.easy_english_meaning: Going hurts, staying away hurts too.

sher.sher:
haal-e-dil yar ko likhun kyunkar
hath dil se juda nahin hota
sher.easy_english_meaning: My hand cannot write; it is holding my aching heart.

sher.sher:
wo nae gile wo shikayaten wo maze maze ki hikayaten
wo har ek baat pe ruthna tumhein yaad ho ki na yaad ho
sher.easy_english_meaning: I still remember our little fights and complaints.

sher.sher:
jise aap ginte the aashna jise aap kahte the ba-wafa
main wahi hun 'momin'-e-mubtala tumhein yaad ho ki na yaad ho
sher.easy_english_meaning: I am the same faithful lover you once knew.

sher.sher:
dil le ke muft kahte hain kuchh kaam ka nahin
ulti shikayaten huin ehsan to gaya
sher.easy_english_meaning: You took my heart, then called it worthless.

sher.sher:
milate ho usi ko khak mein jo dil se milta hai
meri jaan chahne wala badi mushkil se milta hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: True love is rare, yet you destroy it.

sher.sher:
ghazab kiya tere wade pe e'tibar kiya
tamam raat qayamat ka intizar kiya
sher.easy_english_meaning: Trusting your promise made the whole night painful.

sher.sher:
tumhara dil mere dil ke barabar ho nahin sakta
wo shisha ho nahin sakta ye patthar ho nahin sakta
sher.easy_english_meaning: My heart is fragile; yours feels like stone.

sher.sher:
khatir se ya lihaz se main maan to gaya
jhuti qasam se aap ka iman to gaya
sher.easy_english_meaning: I accepted your excuse, but trust was lost.

sher.sher:
aap ka e'tibar kaun kare
roz ka intizar kaun kare
sher.easy_english_meaning: How long can someone keep trusting and waiting?

sher.sher:
raha na dil mein wo bedard aur dard raha
muqim kaun hua hai maqam kis ka tha
sher.easy_english_meaning: The person left, but the pain stayed.

sher.sher:
tumhare khat mein naya ek salam kis ka tha
na tha raqib to aakhir wo nam kis ka tha
sher.easy_english_meaning: Your letter made me fear there was someone else.

sher.sher:
dil gaya tum ne liya hum kya karein
jane wali chiz ka gham kya karein
sher.easy_english_meaning: You took my heart; what can I do now?

sher.sher:
phire rah se wo yahan aate aate
ajal meri rahi tu kahan aate aate
sher.easy_english_meaning: They turned away just before reaching me.

sher.sher:
gahe gahe ki mulaqat hi achchhi hai 'amir'
qadr kho deta hai har roz ka aana jaana
sher.easy_english_meaning: Too much closeness can make love lose its value.

sher.sher:
khanjar chale kisi pe tadapte hain hum 'amir'
sare jahan ka dard hamare jigar mein hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: I feel the pain of the whole world.

sher.sher:
wasl ka din aur itna mukhtasar
din gine jate the is din ke liye
sher.easy_english_meaning: The long-awaited meeting ended far too quickly.

sher.sher:
hans ke farmate hain wo dekh ke haalat meri
kyun tum aasan samajhte the mohabbat meri
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love was never as easy as I imagined.

sher.sher:
shab-e-furqat ka jaga hun farishto ab to sone do
kabhi fursat mein kar lena hisab ahista ahista
sher.easy_english_meaning: Separation kept me awake; now let me finally rest.

sher.sher:
firaq-e-yar ne bechain mujh ko raat bhar rakha
kabhi takiya idhar rakkha kabhi takiya udhar rakkha
sher.easy_english_meaning: Missing you made me restless all night.

sher.sher:
shab-e-wasl bahut kam hai aasman se kaho
ki jod de koi tukda shab-e-judai ka
sher.easy_english_meaning: Meeting nights are short; separation nights feel endless.

sher.sher:
aafat to hai wo naz bhi andaz bhi lekin
marta hun main jis par wo ada aur hi kuchh hai
sher.easy_english_meaning: The very charm that hurts me is what I love.

sher.sher:
putliyan tak bhi to phir jati hain dekho dam-e-naza
waqt padta hai to sab aankh chura jate hain
sher.easy_english_meaning: In the hardest moment, even close ones turn away.

sher.sher:
sarakti jaye hai rukh se naqab ahista ahista
nikalta aa raha hai aftab ahista ahista
sher.easy_english_meaning: Love reveals its beauty slowly, little by little.

sher.sher:
in hasraton se kah do kahin aur ja basen
itni jagah kahan hai dil-e-dagh-dar mein
sher.easy_english_meaning: My wounded heart has no room for more desires.

sher.sher:
tum ne kiya na yaad kabhi bhul kar hamein
hum ne tumhari yaad mein sab kuchh bhula diya
sher.easy_english_meaning: You forgot me; I forgot everything except you.

sher.sher:
kitna hai bad-nasib 'zafar' dafn ke liye
do gaz zamin bhi na mili ku-e-yar mein
sher.easy_english_meaning: Even in death, I could not be near my beloved.

sher.sher:
koi kyun kisi ka lubhae dil koi kya kisi se lagae dil
wo jo bechte the dawa-e-dil wo dukan apni badha gae
sher.easy_english_meaning: Why love when even the healers of hearts are gone?

sher.sher:
lagta nahin hai dil mera ujde dayar mein
kis ki bani hai aalam-e-na-paedar mein
sher.easy_english_meaning: My heart cannot settle in this ruined, temporary world.

sher.sher:
baat karni mujhe mushkil kabhi aisi to na thi
jaisi ab hai teri mahfil kabhi aisi to na thi
sher.easy_english_meaning: We were once close; now even talking feels hard.

sher.sher:
umr-e-daraz mang ke laye the char din
do aarzu mein kat gae do intizar mein
sher.easy_english_meaning: Life passed between desire and waiting.

sher.sher:
be-khudi mein le liya bosa khata kije muaf
ye dil-e-betab ki sari khata thi main na tha
sher.easy_english_meaning: My restless heart acted before reason could stop it.

sher.sher:
tum bhul kar bhi yaad nahin karte ho kabhi
hum to tumhari yaad mein sab kuchh bhula chuke
sher.easy_english_meaning: You never remember me; I remember only you.

sher.sher:
ab to ghabra ke ye kahte hain ki mar jaenge
mar ke bhi chain na paya to kidhar jaenge
sher.easy_english_meaning: The pain feels inescapable, even beyond life.

sher.sher:
ek aansu ne duboya mujh ko un ki bazm mein
bund bhar pani se sari aabru pani hui
sher.easy_english_meaning: One tear exposed all the pain I was hiding.

sher.sher:
laye hayat aaye qaza le chali chale
apni khushi na aaye na apni khushi chale
sher.easy_english_meaning: We enter and leave life without choosing.

sher.sher:
duniya ne kis ka rah-e-fana mein diya hai sath
tum bhi chale chalo yunhi jab tak chali chale
sher.easy_english_meaning: No one stays forever; keep moving while you can.

sher.sher:
dekhna hasrat-e-didar ise kahte hain
phir gaya munh teri jaanib dam-e-murdan apna
sher.easy_english_meaning: Even at death, my last wish was to see you.

sher.sher:
jis ko aate dekhta hun ai pari kahta hun main
aadmi bheja na ho mere bulane ke liye
sher.easy_english_meaning: I keep hoping every visitor brings news from you.

sher.sher:
sar mera kat ke pachhtaiyega
kis ki phir jhuti qasam khaiyega
sher.easy_english_meaning: You may regret hurting the one who trusted you.

sher.sher:
zar diya zor diya mal diya ganj diye
ai falak kaun se rahat ke ewaz ranj diye
sher.easy_english_meaning: Fate gave riches, but too much sorrow with them.

sher.sher:
apne kuche mein mujhe rone to de ai rashk-e-gul
baghban pani hamesha dete hain gulzar ko
sher.easy_english_meaning: Let my tears fall where my love lives.

sher.sher:
zamin bhi nikli jati hai meri panw ke niche se
mujhe mushkil hua hai sath dena apne manzil ka
sher.easy_english_meaning: I feel so lost that even the ground is slipping away.
